name: The Professor Chapter II - The Blach Hand
source:
The Professor and the girls flee for their lives, escape The Black Hand and take possession of a new College in Podunk, Wyoming.  Of course some goofy shit happens along the way, and there's even a sex scene in there somewhere...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/coming-april-2-49324319]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
教授与女孩们为保命而逃亡，摆脱“黑手”，接管了怀俄明州Podunk的一所新学院。当然，途中发生了些傻乎乎的破事，某处甚至还有一场性爱戏……
